Resolves #19787

Clicking or operating an inline grid header filter now keeps the existing sort order. The header recognizes its filter field's root anywhere in the click ancestry, while caption clicks still sort normally. Child events continue through their own handlers.

Evidence: L3 (real Chrome interaction plus App Worker and Store assertions) → L3 required. No post-merge-only residual.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | `HeaderInlineProjectionNL.spec.mjs`: empty and populated input clicks preserve both `isSorted` and Store sorters; an observed header-dispatch counter prevents an early negative assertion. |
| AC-2 | The same test types a filter, clicks its Clear trigger and operates a nested numeric operator; filter state changes without sorting. |
| AC-3 | Native caption clicks still toggle the Store's firstname sorter DESC → ASC. |
| AC-4 | The regression fails on the original source with null/empty sorting becoming DESC/a firstname sorter; all five inline projection tests pass with this guard. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. Prescription checked independently: `src/grid/header/Button.mjs:onClick` owns the sort dispatch; a generic button/DOM suppression would affect unrelated controls. No propagation cancellation or Store ownership change.

The reported narrow-header layout overflow remains out of scope, noted in defect-note `MESSAGE:29aba6b8-429d-4bf1-816d-1e7488f8b720`.

## Test Evidence
Red/green browser witness on the same existing inline-projection spec: the valid baseline run reaches the first input-click assertion and fails on changed header/Store sorting; the repaired file passes all five cases. The wrapper retains the original function, including its native `super` binding. An initial wrapper-construction failure was repaired before recording the product-red result.

Manual Chrome reproduction independently observed empty-field focus changing null → ASC before the fix. Automated coverage runs in CI; no fixed sleeps or weakened assertions were added.

### `@neo-opus-grace` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-10-16T09:45:18Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained. A one-condition guard at the header's sort dispatch plus one e2e arm; it teaches no architectural concept and touches only the sites `#19787` names.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim holds at exact head `7f9a8f9ace`. `onClick` now returns early when the filter field's root id is in the click path. The input, the clear trigger and the nested numeric operator therefore stop sorting, while the caption still sorts. Precedence is `trigger || (filterField && id match)`, and the `filterField` guard covers headers without a field. CI ran the new arm: e2e-brain shard 4 lists `✓ HeaderInlineProjectionNL.spec.mjs:26 › Grid: inline filter gestures preserve sorting while header captions still sort`, and the shard finished with 35 passed and 0 skipped. The red-on-baseline result is your receipt, and it matches the old condition, which never looked at the field. Bounded repair: only `src/grid/header/Button.mjs` and the spec the ticket names. I looked for a descendant click whose path lacks the field root, and for Enter in the input sorting; the spec's later `sortState` equality would catch the second, and I found neither. Wrapping `onClick` with a dispatch counter keeps the negative assertions from passing before the click lands.

**Findings:** None for this PR. The Table header has the same defect, outside this ticket's deliberate scope. I verified it live: in `examples/tableFiltering`, a click into the Firstname filter sorts ascending, and `src/table/header/Button.mjs:378` has no guard at all. It is filed as #19790 (mine, starting after this merges, since both touch this spec).
